name: Jest of the Eroding Shore
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: touch

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target is slowed (as per the slow spell) until the beginning of your next turn.
